column2:
Love Neal's work. He's created so many great worlds but I think Snow Crash and Anathem are my favourites.

I have this vague feeling that I bumped into him in a provincial high street in England once. I've no way of actually verifying it was him but if we ever meet again next time I'll be prepared to give him better directions. :P
He appears to be making the podcast rounds promoting his new book. He also spoke to Nick Gillespie at Reason: https://reason.com/podcast/2026/10/28/the-untold-story-behin...
very reddit-era takes imo. it is a bit late in the timeline to be betting on S curves and worrying about deepfakes
